source_index_lines: - [[mfr-dayton-audio-opal1]] — Parts Express clearance listing, $499 pair (Tier C)
brand_notes: Dayton Audio is Parts Express house brand; OPAL1 is its first upscale finished hi-fi bookshelf (MMAG woofer, dual passive radiators, 200 W, claimed 78.5 dB). Sold via Parts Express/Amazon; clearanced to $499 vs $1,038.99 listed MSRP ($800 per reviews). (eac-dayton-audio-opal1, mfr-dayton-audio-opal1)
takeaways: Very low sensitivity: 75.4 dB computed / 76 dB Audioholics vs 78.5 dB claimed; needs lots of power.
Minimum impedance about 4.5 Ω (EAC) so flagged below-iec for an 8 Ω rating; EPDR 1.9 Ω.
LW ±2.6 dB, f3 51 Hz, wide directivity (139° H); forward ~1 kHz bump with midrange scoop.
THD ~1% at 86 dB and ~3.3% at 96 dB worst case (graph-read, ~100 Hz); compression ≤2.8 dB at 102 dB.
Audioholics 4.5/5 performance, 5/5 value; praised bass for size. No user reports retrievable (forums 403).
conflicts: Sensitivity claimed 78.5 dB vs measured 75.4/76 dB
Woofer size 5.5 in (maker) vs 5-1/4 in (Parts Express)
